sam: quick heads up - saw dashboard webinar signups jump to 420 after the launch posts but Salesforce shows ~295. can someone sanity-check before the weekly KPI review? :mag:
analytics-bot: snapshot: Webinar signups (dashboard) = 420 (+72% WoW); MQLs = 150 (+20%); Sessions from campaign = 4.2k. link: https://redwood.app/dash/webinar_kpis (refreshed 2026-03-18T08:45Z)
lina: we rolled a new shortlink on socials yesterday that strips utm params for some browsers. that could route organic traffic into campaign totals.
chris: also the RSVP widget fires a separate analytics event that our dashboard counts as a signup even if the HubSpot form never posts. i've seen dupes when people click RSVP then fill form.
sam: ok action items: (1) chris - run a distinct email dedupe and confirm true HS contact count, (2) lina - audit the shortlink redirect chain and preserve utm params, (3) analytics - produce a 7d vs 30d attribution comparison for the KPI review.
chris: will run dedupe and post CSV. quick SQL I'll use: SELECT date, COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM webinar_events WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-18' GROUP BY date;
lina: reverting shortlink now and adding utm passthrough param. will confirm when live.
analytics-bot: noted tasks created: #MKT-981 (dedupe), #MKT-982 (utm audit). scheduled refresh to include deduped count at 2026-03-18T09:30Z.
sam: great. we'll present both numbers in the weekly KPI review and call out attribution variation. thanks team :thumbsup:
